lucky_shot.effect_en: Gives a %(highlight_start)%(chancePerLevel)%%(highlight_end) chance of making an accurate shot when dispersion is more than %(highlight_start)%(shotDispersionFactor)%%(highlight_end) higher than the minimum value.
lucky_shot.tip_en: Most useful for tanks firing on the move.
lucky_shot.effect_zh-Hans: 当误差超过最小值%(highlight_start)%(shotDispersionFactor)%%(highlight_end)时，有%(highlight_start)%(chancePerLevel)%%(highlight_end)几率发动一次精准射击。
lucky_shot.tip_zh-Hans: 可以显著提升坦克移动中攻击的命中率。

surrounded_by_enemy.effect_en: Increases tank acceleration by %(highlight_start)%(enginePowerFactorPerLevel)%%(highlight_end) if there are at least %(highlight_start)%(enemyCount)%(highlight_end) enemies within %(highlight_start)%(enemyInRadius)%(highlight_end) meters of your tank.
surrounded_by_enemy.tip_en: Most useful for tanks actively engaged in offensive combat.
surrounded_by_enemy.effect_zh-Hans: 如果您的坦克半径%(highlight_start)%(enemyInRadius)%(highlight_end)内有至少%(highlight_start)%(enemyCount)%(highlight_end)辆敌方坦克，则提高坦克加速度%(highlight_start)%(enginePowerFactorPerLevel)%%(highlight_end)。
surrounded_by_enemy.tip_zh-Hans: 是对进攻型坦克最为有效。

soft_recoil.tip_en: Most useful for tanks with automatic loading.
soft_recoil.tip_zh-Hans: 对自动装弹型坦克最为有效。

skilled_ranging.effect_en: Fire %(highlight_start)3%(highlight_end) shots in a row and deal damage with each shot to get a %(highlight_start)%(activationChancePerLevel)%%(highlight_end) chance of dealing maximum damage with the next shot.
skilled_ranging.tip_en: Fire only when you are sure you will deal damage.
skilled_ranging.features_en: A series is broken by a miss or a shot that deals no damage.
skilled_ranging.effect_zh-Hans: 连续%(highlight_start)3%(highlight_end)次射击并造成伤害时，每次射击有%(highlight_start)%(activationChancePerLevel)%%(highlight_end)几率使下次攻击造成最大伤害。
skilled_ranging.tip_zh-Hans: 只在确定能造成伤害时射击。
skilled_ranging.features_zh-Hans: 射击发生未命中或未造成伤害会中断连续纪录。

fast_capture.features_en: Capturing a base alongside an ally who has this skill increases the base capture speed by an additional %(highlight_start)10%%(highlight_end).
fast_capture.features_zh-Hans: 在一名具有此技能的队友身边占领基地时占领速度额外增加%(highlight_start)10%%(highlight_end)。

battle_rage.effect_en: Accelerates gun reloading by %(highlight_start)%(reloadFactorPerLevel)%%(highlight_end) for the next shot after you destroy an enemy tank.
battle_rage.tip_en: Most useful for tanks with high damage per shot and a long reload time.
battle_rage.features_en: Ineffective for guns with automatic loading.
battle_rage.effect_zh-Hans: 击毁一辆敌方坦克后，提高下次攻击的装填速度%(highlight_start)%(reloadFactorPerLevel)%%(highlight_end)。
battle_rage.tip_zh-Hans: 对单发伤害高但装填速度慢的坦克最为有效。

armour_piercing.effect_en: Provides a %(highlight_start)%(chancePerLevel)%%(highlight_end) chance of scoring a hit with increased armor penetration.
armour_piercing.features_en: When this skill is activated, penetration is 100% to 105% of the value shown in tank characteristics. Normally, penetration ranges from 95% to 105%.
armour_piercing.effect_zh-Hans: 有%(highlight_start)%(chancePerLevel)%%(highlight_end)几率提高攻击的护甲穿透。
armour_piercing.features_zh-Hans: 技能激活时，穿透深度提升至坦克基础属性的100%–105%。通常，穿透深度范围为基础值的95%–105%。

tutor.effect_en: Increases Crew XP earned in battle by %(highlight_start)%(xpBonusFactorPerLevel)%%(highlight_end).

smooth_driving.effect_en: Decreases gun dispersion by %(highlight_start)%(shotDispersionFactorPerLevel)%%(highlight_end) when firing on the move.
smooth_driving.tip_en: Most useful for tanks firing on the move.
smooth_driving.tip_zh-Hans: 可以显著提升坦克移动中攻击的命中率。

smooth_turret.effect_en: Decreases gun dispersion by %(highlight_start)%(shotDispersionFactorPerLevel)%%(highlight_end) during turret traverse.
smooth_turret.tip_en: Most useful for tanks firing on the move.
smooth_turret.features_en: Decreases dispersion on gun movement when applied to tanks without turrets.
smooth_turret.effect_zh-Hans: 降低炮塔转动时的射击误差%(highlight_start)%(shotDispersionFactorPerLevel)%%(highlight_end)。
smooth_turret.tip_zh-Hans: 可以显著提升坦克移动中攻击的命中率。
smooth_turret.features_zh-Hans: 无炮塔坦克的效果为降低炮管转动时的射击误差。

skilled_repairer.effect_en: Reduces effectiveness loss of critically damaged modules by %(highlight_start)%(penaltyFactorPerLevel)%%(highlight_end).
skilled_repairer.effect_zh-Hans: 降低模块严重受损时的性能损失%(highlight_start)%(penaltyFactorPerLevel)%%(highlight_end)。

close_combat_master.effect_en: Increases turret turn rate by %(highlight_start)%(turretRotationSpeedFactorPerLevel)%%(highlight_end) if there is an enemy within %(highlight_start)%(enemyInRadius)%(highlight_end) meters of your tank.
close_combat_master.tip_en: Most useful for heavy tanks with a low turret turn rate.
close_combat_master.effect_zh-Hans: 您的坦克半径%(highlight_start)%(enemyInRadius)%(highlight_end)米内有敌人时，提高炮塔转向速率%(highlight_start)%(turretRotationSpeedFactorPerLevel)%%(highlight_end)。
close_combat_master.tip_zh-Hans: 对炮塔转向速率低下的重型坦克最为有效。

fire_fighting.tip_en: Most useful for tanks with a high chance of catching fire when hit.
fire_fighting.tip_zh-Hans: 对容易起火的坦克最为有效。

desperado.effect_en: Accelerates gun loading by %(highlight_start)%(gunReloadTimeFactorPerLevel)%%(highlight_end) when the tank has less than %(highlight_start)%(vehicleHealthFraction)%%(highlight_end) HP remaining.
desperado.tip_en: Most useful for tanks with high durability and thick armor.
desperado.effect_zh-Hans: 当坦克生命值低于%(highlight_start)%(vehicleHealthFraction)%%(highlight_end)时，提高装填速度%(highlight_start)%(gunReloadTimeFactorPerLevel)%%(highlight_end)。
desperado.tip_zh-Hans: 对高生命值和高护甲的坦克最为有效。

repair.effect_en: Decreases repair time for broken modules by %(highlight_start)%(repairSpeedFactorPerLevel)%%(highlight_end).

sniper.effect_en: Gives a %(highlight_start)%(chancePerLevel)%%(highlight_end) chance of making a shot that is guaranteed to deal damage to an enemy tank module if you hit it.
sniper.features_en: When this skill is activated, the chance of damaging an enemy tank module is %(highlight_start)%(deviceChanceToHitBoost)%%(highlight_end). Normally, the chance of damage depends on the module type and ranges from 27% to 100%.
sniper.effect_zh-Hans: 击中敌方坦克时，有%(highlight_start)%(chancePerLevel)%%(highlight_end)几率必定对模块造成伤害。
sniper.features_zh-Hans: 当技能激活时，击伤敌方坦克模块的几率提升至 %(highlight_start)%(deviceChanceToHitBoost)%%(highlight_end)。一般情况下，该几率取决于模块类型和距离数值在27%—100%之间。

deadly_accuracy.effect_en: Increases view range and aiming speed by %(highlight_start)%(aimingFactorPerLevel)%%(highlight_end) if all your allies are destroyed.
deadly_accuracy.effect_zh-Hans: 当队友全部阵亡时，提高视野范围和瞄准速度%(highlight_start)%(aimingFactorPerLevel)%%(highlight_end)。

camouflage.tip_en: Most useful for small, low-profile tanks.
camouflage.tip_zh-Hans: 对小型低车身的坦克最为有效。

smooth_turn.effect_en: Decreases gun dispersion of a turning tank by %(highlight_start)%(shotDispersionFactorPerLevel)%%(highlight_end).
smooth_turn.effect_zh-Hans: 降低坦克转向时的射击误差%(highlight_start)%(shotDispersionFactorPerLevel)%%(highlight_end)。
